insight.mets_rationalization: This aligns with the METS-Ops category as it involves the supply and integration of physical machinery (Remote Weapon Systems) into military vehicles, directly supporting the modernization of Canada's land defense capabilities and reinforcing the supply chain for critical national infrastructure.
